item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu verses from its Roman text, and check that both versions align stanza by stanza.

Masjid Hai Qatal Gah Janab-e-Ameer Ki
Peshani Khoon Mein Tar Hai Nabi Ke Wazeer Ki

1
Badla Liya Gaya Hai Ali Se Namaz Mein
Thi Dushmani Rasool Se Rooz-e-Ghadeer Ki
Zainab Ne Jane Kaisay Ayelan Yeh Suna
Maiyyat Uthai Jaye Janab-e-Ameer Ki

2
Muslim Se Bolay Maula Nabi Ka Safeer Hoon
Iss Shehar Mein Yeh Hoti Hai Halat Safeer Ki
Tareekh Se Sawal Hai Gar Kofi Shia They
Inn Kofiyon Ne Aal-e-Nabi Kyun Aseer Ki

3
Shabeer Dekhtey Hain Yateemo Ki Ik Qatar
Zakhmi Ali Ko Iss Ghari Hajat Hai Sheer Ki
Akbar Yeh Faiz Midhat-e-Aal-e-Batool Hai
Jholi Bhari Hoi Hai Najaf Ke Faqeer Ki

p = 'src/data/lyrics/masjid-hai-qatal-gah-janab-e-ameer-ki-lyrics-2021-tajpoints-fb52c9f2d6c261d1a59e.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---',2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert roman.casefold() == old.casefold()
blocks = [s.splitlines() for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]

assert [b[0] for b in blocks[1:]] == list('۱۲۳')
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Roman wording and stanza alignment verified.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, with capitalization adjusted. Verified that the opening and all three stanzas align. Added the Urdu title, retained the Roman alternate title, set right-to-left direction, and cleared `noUrdu`.

I read *sheer* as شیر (milk) from the context of the wounded Ali.
